facts.text: I've never had an episode like this before.
I don't have any significant medical problems.
My husband died recently in a tragic car accident.
Since losing my husband I've been under a great deal of emotional and psychological stress.
My brother brought me to the emergency department.

findings.name: lung auscultation
findings.result: Rales in the right and left lower lung lobes.

findings.name: echocardiography
findings.result: Enlarged left ventricle and left atrium.

aliases: transient left ventricular apical ballooning syndrome

quotes.f005: recently lost her husband in a tragic car accident
quotes.f006: experiencing a significant amount of emotional stress / acute emotional and psychological stress
quotes.f007: brought to the emergency department by her brother

x006.source_text: Rales in the lower right and left lung lobes

x008.source_text: Enlarged left ventricle and left atrium

source_issues: The echocardiogram shows an enlarged left ventricle and atrium rather than the transient apical ballooning typical of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, and the ECG is normal; no troponin or coronary angiography is given, so the tests support the gold diagnosis weakly.
No temperature is given; lung auscultation is filed under Cardiac_Examination.
Social_History has no own content ('No specific details provided. Attention to recent emotional trauma is noted.').
notes: The chief complaint 'Severe chest pain' gives the opening: chest pain and its severity (child fact).
The source has no further chest-pain characteristics (onset, character, radiation); they stay unknown.

The bereavement and the resulting emotional stress are social_background facts (stressor). The stress appears in History, Secondary_Symptoms, Past_Medical_History and Social_History and is one fact (f006).
'The patient appears to be in distress' (p006) is an observer sign not in the exam leaves; moved to qc.extras.acting_notes.
'No significant past medical history mentioned' (p003) and 'No significant past medical history' (p004) are read as one denial.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Evaluate the patient presenting with severe chest pain and provide a diagnosis based on the clinical findings and test results presented.
acting_notes: Appears to be in distress due to the chest pain and recent emotional events (source Review_of_Systems p006).
